name: Spermatozoon (sperm)
short_description: Highly polarized, streamlined male germ cell (~55-60 micrometres long): a flattened oval head carrying the haploid, ultra-condensed nucleus under an enzyme-filled acrosomal cap, a short neck with the centrioles, a mitochondria-wrapped midpiece for ATP, and a long flagellar tail (principal piece + end piece) built around a 9+2 axoneme that drives whip-like swimming toward the egg.

textbook.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; paddle-shaped head cutaway with condensed-chromatin nucleus + acrosomal cap over the front two-thirds, teal proximal centriole at the neck, coiled orange mitochondrial sheath around the midpiece axoneme, tapering principal piece + bare end piece; muted educational palette matches house look)

sem.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; smooth flattened oval head, distinct neck/midpiece transition, long gently-tapering whip-like tail to a fine tip, warm sandy-bronze false colour on dark charcoal-blue background, surface only as expected for SEM)
sem.2: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; same anatomy from the opposite diagonal, comparable quality — kept as an alternate attempt, attempt 1 used as final)

3d.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; vertical composition, correct cutaway anatomy and natural tints, less dynamic framing - superseded)
3d.2: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; diagonal composition showing the full tail length, correct cutaway with nucleus/acrosome/centriole/mitochondrial sheath/axoneme/fibrous sheath all distinguishable, natural biological tones, no border - used as final)

watercolor.1: pass (gemini-2.5-flash-image; full-bleed aged paper, ink-outlined cutaway head with violet nucleus + cream acrosomal cap + teal centriole dot, twisted reddish-orange mitochondrial sheath at the midpiece, long tapering tail sweeping across the page, single specimen, no text/border)
